slots.jd.retail-enterprise.about:
Position summary
Marlowe Retail Systems, a national retail company, seeks a Backend Engineer to design, build and maintain the services that support its retail operations. The engineer will work within a cross-functional team to keep these services reliable, efficient and well documented.
Minimum: experience building backend services in Python on Linux and supporting automated deployment pipelines.
Preferred: familiarity with Kafka and Kubernetes.
slots.jd.retail-enterprise.duties:
Responsibilities
- Maintain the reliability of production backend services and take part in a shared on-call rotation.
- Investigate and tune slow database queries to keep service response times within agreed targets.
- Automate and improve deployment pipelines so that releases are repeatable and low risk.
- Lead follow-up reviews after incidents and keep operational runbooks current.
- Collaborate with product and infrastructure teams to plan changes to services and data stores.
slots.jd.retail-enterprise.needs:
Minimum and preferred qualifications
- 4 or more years of professional experience in backend software engineering.
- Strong working knowledge of Python and of operating services on Linux.
- Experience building and maintaining CI pipelines in Jenkins.
- Experience managing infrastructure as code with Terraform.
- Practical experience with PostgreSQL, including query tuning and schema changes.
- Familiarity with API versioning practices and backward-compatible interface design.
slots.r1.b1: Maintain Spring Boot services and share the on-call rotation, reducing paging incidents by 15 percent through clearer alerting and health checks.
slots.r1.b2: Tune slow database queries and manage the supporting database infrastructure with Terraform so configuration changes stay reviewed and repeatable.
slots.r1.b3: Lead incident follow-ups and write runbooks, adding Jenkins jobs for common recovery steps that cut time to resolution by 25 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Plan and apply database schema changes on Linux hosts, staging each migration so services stay available during rollout.
slots.r1.i1: At Alder Systems, the work centers on finding and tuning slow queries across the backend services.
slots.r1.i2: At Alder Systems, the role covers designing backend APIs and managing their versioning so client teams can upgrade without disruption.
slots.r2.b1: Designed and versioned GraphQL APIs for internal clients, reducing breaking-change support requests by 40 percent.
slots.r2.b2: Automated deployment pipelines for services running on Kubernetes, replacing manual release steps with repeatable rollouts.
slots.r2.b3: Wrote Python health checks and alerting tools for the on-call rotation, cutting repeat incidents by 45 percent.
slots.r2.b4: Tuned slow queries behind Kafka consumers, clearing processing backlogs during peak traffic.
slots.r2.i1: At Dunmore Technologies, the role focused on designing backend APIs and handling their versioning for internal client teams.
slots.r2.i2: At Dunmore Technologies, the work included following up on incidents and writing runbooks for the on-call team.
slots.summary.1: Backend engineer with about 4 years of experience owning a service or workstream end to end, from design through on-call support. Builds services in Python, event pipelines with Kafka, and APIs with GraphQL.
slots.summary.2: Mid-level backend software engineer with about 4 years of experience taking a single service or workstream from planning to production and ongoing support. Works daily with Python, Kafka and GraphQL to build reliable, maintainable backend systems.
